department: Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science (Doctoral Committee in Mathematics)

deadline.value: The faculty has no application deadlines; decisions take about 1 week to 2 months.

entry_route.value: The typical applicant holds a Master's degree or Diploma in mathematics (at least four years of university study including the bachelor's); other degrees are decided case by case.
